name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A style guide and template pack that makes AI coding assistants draw clean, professional-looking diagrams instead of messy default flowcharts.
buyer: A technical consultant or startup founder who needs polished architecture or process diagrams for decks and docs without hiring a designer.
business_use_cases: A technical consultant generates polished client-facing architecture diagrams for proposals and reports in minutes.
A startup founder makes a professional-looking product or process diagram for an investor pitch deck without a designer.
A docs or content agency sells 'AI-diagrammed documentation' as a premium add-on service to clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid diagram-generation service: clients describe their system, you deliver polished diagrams using this toolkit.
Build a hosted web app around these templates where non-coders pay monthly to generate branded diagrams.

steal_this: This weekend, build and sell a 'pitch deck diagram pack' service on Fiverr or Upwork using this template set, targeting founders prepping investor decks.
